description: I had the pleasure of working with Jayson Bejoy of Trispark during my job search, and I can't recommend him highly enough. He played a crucial role in converting me with an incredible opportunity, which not only offered a higher salary but also came with better benefits. Jayson acted as a true liaison between me and the employer, guiding me through every step of the hiring process with professionalism and expertise. His clear communication, industry knowledge, and commitment to my success made all the difference. He ensured I was well-prepared and kept me informed at every stage, making the experience seamless and stress-free. If you're looking for a recruiter who genuinely cares about finding the right fit for both candidates and employers, Jayson is the person to trust. I'm incredibly grateful for his support and highly recommend him to anyone seeking career advancement!
name: Courtney Lambert

description: The onboarding process for Trispark Healthcare has been very lengthy, but Ken Clark has made it tolerable and manageable. Ken's calm demeanor and explanation for each task allow the task not to seem so tedious. I was able to contact Ken with my questions and receive a reply fairly quickly. All my questions and concerns were addressed, and he made me feel comfortable working with Trispark Healthcare. It has been a pleasure to work with Ken as my onboarding specialist. Thank you for your support in this process and starting my new position with Harlem Hospital.
name: Ebony

description: Shaina and I have been partnering together for the better part of a year now, working to fill direct hire needs at my largest client. We have had so much success that she is my go-to for any of my DH needs! A few things that stand out about Shaina include her pleasant demeanor, excellent attention to detail, prompt and conscientious communication style, and her ability to take constructive criticism in stride. If you have a client in a hospital/healthcare setting that needs help sourcing quality direct hires/staff, I highly recommend you reach out to Shaina and her team over at Trispark, LLC.
name: Nate

description: I'm happy to recommend Chris Baker of Trispark to anyone looking for a committed, knowledgeable recruiter. From our first conversation, Chris took the time to understand my goals and skills and then matched me with opportunities that truly fit my needs. He kept the entire process organized—scheduling interviews quickly, preparing me for each step, and making sure I had all the information I needed to succeed. Chris's professionalism, clear communication, and genuine care made what can be a stressful experience straightforward and positive. If you want a recruiter who will advocate for you from first application until after you're hired, Chris Baker is the person you want assisting you.
name: Joe
